## Common quote traps
- Automatic SaaS upgrades: ask how customisations and integrations are re-tested before each upgrade.
- Maintenance end dates for on-premise versions (Divalto table above) — plan the upgrade before extended maintenance ends.
- PA partner fees per invoice not included.
